Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 15 minutes Total time: 25 minutes Number of Servings: 6 Ingredients 3 pounds fresh asparagus spears 1 teaspoon oil dash of salt and pepper Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Preheat oven to 400 °F. Wash asparagus spears and trim off tough ends. Leave whole or cut into shorter lengths. In a large bowl, toss spears with the oil, salt, and pepper. Place spears in a single layer on a large baking sheet. Lining the baking sheet with foil or baking parchment will help with clean-up. Roast for 12 to 15 minutes or until the asparagus pieces are lightly browned. Thick spears will take a longer baking time. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Try adding more seasonings such as lemon zest or garlic powder.
